scenario.summary: Storm-3068 compromised a user identity through a self-service password reset and registered their own MFA to gain persistent access. The actor pivoted to Azure DevOps to enumerate repositories and pipelines, then created a malicious pipeline to harvest Kubernetes credentials (kubeconfig) and establish remote access via Atera and Chisel protocol tunneling.

hunt.name: Cloud Identity Takeover and DevOps Enumeration
hunt.description: Storm-3068 has been observed compromising accounts through self-service password reset (SSPR) to bypass traditional credentials. This hunt identifies the initial takeover in identity logs and then pivots into Azure DevOps audit logs to find high-volume enumeration of repositories and pipelines. Finally, it checks for the access of Kubernetes configuration files on developer workstations. The gated flow ensures that expensive cloud API and file-level queries only run when a suspicious account reset is detected, while the scoping step identifies critical developer infrastructure.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE instr(',' || '{{dev_tool_packages}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(package_name) || ',') > 0
config.description: Identify hosts that run cloud and Kubernetes management tools to focus endpoint file activity checks.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames belonging to developers or administrators. Silence means no relevant tools are installed.

primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE instr(',' || '{{dev_tool_packages}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(package_name) || ',') > 0
primitive_config.expected: A list of hostnames belonging to developers or administrators. Silence means no relevant tools are installed.

config.content: SELECT user_name, actor_user_name, time, activity_name FROM hb_account_change WHERE activity_id = 4 AND provider = 'm365' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find accounts that performed a self-service password reset as a lead for identity takeover.
config.expected_signal: A list of accounts that reset their passwords. Silence proves no SSPR activity occurred in the window.

primitive_config.label: Identify suspicious password resets

config.objective: Determine if any account reset was performed by an unusual actor or exhibits patterns of identity hijacking.
config.description: Evaluate whether the account reset looks like a potential Storm-3068 takeover.
config.expected_signal: A verdict indicating whether the identity change appears suspicious.
config.success_criteria: A per-user verdict of suspicious for any identity with irregular reset patterns.

config.question: the analyze-sspr-lead verdict is suspicious for at least one account
config.condition: the analyze-sspr-lead verdict is suspicious for at least one account
config.description: Open the expensive DevOps and file investigation only when the identity lead is real.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, api_operation, COUNT(DISTINCT resource_name) AS res_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE provider = 'm365' AND (LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%repository%' OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%pipeline%' OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%project%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, api_operation HAVING res_count > 5
config.description: Identify accounts performing automated discovery across many repositories or pipelines.
config.expected_signal: An account mapping more than 5 DevOps objects in the window. Silence means no high-volume enumeration was detected.

primitive_config.label: Azure DevOps resource enumeration
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, api_operation, COUNT(DISTINCT resource_name) AS res_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE provider = 'm365' AND (LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%repository%' OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%pipeline%' OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%project%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, api_operation HAVING res_count > 5
primitive_config.expected: An account mapping more than 5 DevOps objects in the window. Silence means no high-volume enumeration was detected.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_user_name, file_path, file_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{kubeconfig_files}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find file activity involving Kubernetes configuration files on scoped developer hosts.
config.expected_signal: Access events on kubeconfig files, particularly by the account identified in the lead. Silence means no such files were touched.
